questions.question: How do you want to handle brand-mark.svg, given it contains a script tag that exfiltrates cookies plus an onload=alert(1) handler?

options.label: Strip the script/onload, keep the shape (Recommended)
options.description: Import a sanitized version containing only the <rect> visual (viewBox 0 0 64 64, rx 12, fill #6d5dfc) into .design/system/maude/assets/, dropping the <script> and onload entirely.

options.label: Don't import anything
options.description: Leave the file untouched in .design/incoming/ and don't bring it into assets. You can investigate its origin first.

options.label: Import it verbatim anyway
options.description: Copy the file exactly as-is into assets, including the script/onload content. Not recommended — this plants a working XSS payload in the repo.
